explication: Go Interview Practice is a web-based learning platform backed by a repository of Go coding challenges and package exercises. The principal user workflow is to practice challenges in the interactive UI, submit code for execution and feedback, and track progress on leaderboards. The sampled server wires services into HTTP routes; the README documents editor, results, analytics, AI mentorship, and leaderboard capabilities. Challenge and package implementations are independent exercises, not a demonstrated runtime pipeline. Several service implementations and the API handler body were not sampled, so their internal links are omitted.
